class.name: NetwPersistenceHandle
class.brief_description: One entity's stored row, reached as [member NetwEntity.persistence].
class.description: The session authority compiles the entity's [NetwPersistenceConfig] and every [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] declaration under it into one row when the entity's node is ready. A declaration that does not hold refuses the whole entity with an error naming the property and the column, so an entity either saves its whole row or saves nothing. Code that depends on the stored values waits for [signal loaded]. [method Node._ready] runs before the row is read. A save freezes its values at the moment it is submitted. A property that moved while the write was in flight leaves the entity [member dirty] after the acknowledgement, so the next save carries the newer value. [codeblock] func _on_chest_opened() -> void: var row := entity.persistence row.saved.connect(func() -> void: print("stored as ", row.record_id)) row.save() [/codeblock] [method NetwPersistenceConfig.interval] saves the row on its own cadence, and an entity that changed nothing submits no write at all. An entity whose node leaves the tree for good writes the values it held as it left, and the write completes after the node is freed. A move to another parent writes nothing and keeps the row bound. A final write the database refuses stays owed, and [method NetwSessionHandle.save_entities] writes it again. A load or save that fails emits [signal NetwDatabase.failed] on the entity's database. The interval and the final write have no caller to answer, so that signal is where their failures arrive.

method.name: load
method.description: Reads the stored row and applies it to the bound properties. The promise answers [code]true[/code] when a row was found and [code]false[/code] when none was stored, which leaves the entity's own values standing. While the read started by [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn] is outstanding, this returns that same promise. A failed load fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] answers the code. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the entity binds no persistence, the database is not open, │ or the schema declares no migration from the stored row ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer holds no session authority ┠╴ERR_BUSY a bound property changed since the last load or save, a │ write is in flight, a property changed while the row was │ read, or the database is full ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST a bound node was freed while the row was applied ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED the stored row is not in this library's format, or carries │ a newer storage version than the schema ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the stored row does not match the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE session authority moved, the database closed or the session │ ended while the row was read, so the load was canceled ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the row [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the bound properties as this entity's row. The promise answers [code]false[/code] when nothing had changed and no write was submitted. A write the database refused never becomes the saved values, so the entity stays [member dirty] and the next save carries them again. A failed save fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] answers the code. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the entity binds no persistence, or the database is not open ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer holds no session authority, so its values are a │ replicated copy ┠╴ERR_BUSY a write is in flight, the spawn load has not succeeded, or │ the database is full ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the bound values do not match the schema, or the connection │ answered no outcome for the row ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the bound nodes are gone, or authority moved or the database │ closed before the write settled. The write may still have │ reached storage ┖╴backend-defined the backend refused or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: The [NetwDatabase] this row lives in, as [method NetwPersistenceConfig.database] named it.
Whether any bound property differs from what was last saved.
The key this row is stored under, as [method NetwPersistenceConfig.record_id] answered it when the entity bound.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted once a load has applied the stored row, including the read [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn] starts. [param found] is [code]false[/code] when the database held no row for [member record_id]. A failed load emits [signal NetwDatabase.failed] instead.

signal.name: saved
signal.description: Emitted once a write has been acknowledged and its values have become the saved ones. A refused write emits [signal NetwDatabase.failed] instead.
